text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from our outing, Winning Ticket and I stop at a bookstore in town.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoaaaa! This is… No waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be totally absorbed in a novel she picked up. Later on…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HEEEEY! Taishiiiin! Hayahideeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back at the academy, she runs at full pelt over to her two friends, Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The three of us are inseparable! We were born in different places, but from now on, we're brothers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Brothers?! What're you going on about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Ticket, tell me. Have you perhaps recently read "Romance of the Three Kingdoms"?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's totally right! I read it at a bookstore just now, and it was so moving!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanna be your brother-in-arms! Who would you wanna play? Which character?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whyyyy?! Come on, if you don't do it, I'll have to find someone else!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pleeease, I really wanna be your brother, Taishin! It wouldn't be the same with anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I said I don't want to. It's so childish.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I get how you feel, but you know Ticket is never going to give up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Besides, with her enthusiasm, she might rope in the entire academy into playing a "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That sounds terrifying… Fine, I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good. Now, shall we get this over with?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The Oath of the Peach Garden… If I were to choose one out of the three warriors in this scene, I'd be…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Guan Yu. I swear on my Green Dragon Crescent Blade and, er, beard to fight for salvation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How's that? I suppose I'm the wise general. You're up next.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay… Uh… I don't wanna be a musclebrain like Zhang Fei, so…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey. I'm Liu Bei, and as the oldest, I'll set the world straight. Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right, next. Finish the oath.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My name is Tickezo! Thank you for joining me, brothers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tickezo's not part of the story! Didn't you say you loved the book? You forgot your character already!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There wasn't a Tickezo? Aww… In that case…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My name is Ticketarooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is nuts. "Ticketaro" doesn't even sound Chinese. Geez…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but I'm glad she at least read a historical novel. We can learn a lot from the past.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it seems you're somewhat knowledgeable too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There are so many historical novels. Which one do you think would be most useful for Winning Ticket to experience?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, The Three Musketeers —the famous French tale. A story from a country that loves racing would certainly be useful.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm… Oh, I've heard of that one.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay! Then let's do that too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Only for a little while. Now let's see…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My name is Athos. I will lead you to honorable victory!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm Aramis. I focus on being flashy for the ladies, but well, who cares.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My name is TICKEZOOO! I'm all for you, my brothers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Stop that! Pick either Porthos or D'Artagnan, and stop inserting yourself!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay! My name is D'a… D'al… DALMATIAN!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's a dog… But at least you're on the right track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now, it would be a poor lesson if we stopped at introductions alone—we should delve a little further into French culture. There's ballroom dancing, or…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ballroom dancing?! All riiight, that's it! Let's get dancing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, you two! Dance like nobody's watching!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I suppose dancing would be more productive than playing a character.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, yeah. I'm stuck on wherever this ride goes, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of them practice dancing until they're drenched in sweat.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wooow, so this is the world of The Three Musketeers! It's so incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure the musketeers did any dancing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Did you see, Trainer? Isn't this neat?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: New, heart-touching experiences can help me grow! They'll make me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The excitement of races is great, but let's look for even more cool and exciting things!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, let's gooo! YEAH! I'M DALMATIAN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the dalmatian—I mean, Winning Ticket—starts looking for all kinds of emotionally touching moments.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ahh, the Sengoku period… It is important to study the history of one's own country.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sengoku! I know a little about that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Speaking of… Taishin, wasn't there someone important in history with your name?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I dunno, was there a warlord called Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let me remember. His name was…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taika no Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa! Isn't that cool? You share a name with someone super famous!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's not a person! You're thinking of Taika no Kaishin. I'm not a reformation period!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I think there was a Hayahide too. Uh, what was he called… Kobayakawa Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaah! I put my trust in you, Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wrong—that's Kobayakawa Hideaki. And don't trust him. He's got red flags of betrayal all over his history.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiight! The battle is about to begin! Everyone, to waaaarrr!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh… She certainly keeps us busy. But I guess running around is more effective than fooling around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, if we're gonna run, I don't mind so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of them wildly dash around like the warlords of old.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: This… this is truly the Sengoku period! Waaaah! I'm really feeling it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haha, we didn't go to war or anything. It was just training like usual.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Did you see, Trainer? Isn't this neat?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: New, heart-touching experiences can help me grow! They'll make me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The excitement of races is great, but let's look for even more cool and exciting things!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiight! Let's go! I will unite this land into a wondrous country! To Honno-ji Temple!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure how it worked out, but she's in high spirits. That's how Winning Ticket starts looking for all kinds of emotionally touching moments.
